3- to 5-series cell Li-Ion battery monitor AFE with I2C. Integrated cell balancing, charge/discharge FET drivers, LDO, coulomb counter. TSSOP-20.

600V 50mohm GaN FET with integrated gate driver. Do NOT use if VBUS > 480V.

256-Mbit SDRAM, 16-bit bus, 4 banks, 166 MHz. TSOP-II 54-pin. 3.3V.

Hardwired TCP/IP embedded Ethernet controller with SPI interface. Requires 25MHz crystal on XI/CLKIN and XO. Multiple VCC3V3A and GNDA pins must all be connected. TOCAP requires 4.7uF cap to GNDA. 1V2O requires 1uF cap to GND. EXRES1 requires 12.4k resistor to GND.

Hex Schmitt-trigger inverter. Contains 6 independent inverter gates. Pin names are '~' in KiCad; use pin numbers. Odd pins (1,3,5,9,11,13) are inputs, even pins (2,4,6,8,10,12) are outputs for each gate pair.

Quad bus buffer with 3-state outputs. Pin names are '~' in KiCad; use pin numbers. For each gate: OE (active-low) controls output enable. Gate1: OE=1, A=2, Y=3. Gate2: OE=4, A=5, Y=6. Gate3: OE=10, A=9, Y=8. Gate4: OE=13, A=12, Y=11.
Hex inverter. Contains 6 independent inverter gates. Pin names are '~' in KiCad; use pin numbers. Odd pins (1,3,5,9,11,13) are inputs, even pins (2,4,6,8,10,12) are outputs for each gate pair.
Quad 2-input NAND gate. Pin names are '~' in KiCad; use pin numbers. Gate1: A=1,B=2,Y=3. Gate2: A=4,B=5,Y=6. Gate3: A=9,B=10,Y=8. Gate4: A=12,B=13,Y=11.
Quad 2-input AND gate. Pin names are '~' in KiCad; use pin numbers. Gate1: A=1,B=2,Y=3. Gate2: A=4,B=5,Y=6. Gate3: A=9,B=10,Y=8. Gate4: A=12,B=13,Y=11.
Quad 2-input OR gate. Pin names are '~' in KiCad; use pin numbers. Gate1: A=1,B=2,Y=3. Gate2: A=4,B=5,Y=6. Gate3: A=9,B=10,Y=8. Gate4: A=12,B=13,Y=11.
Octal buffer/line driver with 3-state inverting outputs. G1 (pin 1) and G2 (pin 19) are active-low output enables. A0-A7 are inputs, Y0-Y7 are outputs.
Octal buffer/line driver with 3-state non-inverting outputs. G1 (pin 1) and G2 (pin 19) are active-low output enables. A0-A7 are inputs, Y0-Y7 are outputs.
Quad 2-input NAND gate (AC family). Named pins: A0-A3 and B0-B3 are inputs, Y0-Y3 are outputs.
Quad 2-input NOR gate (AC family). Named pins: A0-A3 and B0-B3 are inputs, Y0-Y3 are outputs.
Quad 2-input XOR gate (AC family). Named pins: A0-A3 and B0-B3 are inputs, Y0-Y3 are outputs.
USB to UART bridge IC. No external crystal needed. V3 pin (pin 4) is the internal 3.3V regulator output; connect a 100nF decoupling cap to GND. For 5V operation, connect V3 to VCC.

USB Type-C receptacle for USB 2.0. Has duplicate pins for both orientations (A and B sides). D+ pins (A6,B6) should be tied together, D- pins (A7,B7) should be tied together. CC1 and CC2 each need a 5.1k pull-down for device mode or 56k pull-up for host mode. SHIELD (S1) connects to chassis ground, optionally via RC filter.
USB Type-C receptacle, power only (6 pins). No data lines. CC1 and CC2 each need 5.1k pull-down for sink, or 56k pull-up for source.
USB Micro-B receptacle. ID pin (pin 4) is typically left floating for device mode or grounded for OTG host mode.
LoRa transceiver module (868 MHz). SPI interface for communication. DIO0-DIO5 are configurable interrupt/status outputs. ANT is the RF antenna pin. 3.3V supply only.

ESP8266 WiFi module. GPIO0 must be HIGH for normal boot (pull-up). GPIO15 must be LOW for normal boot (pull-down). EN (chip enable) must be pulled HIGH. RST needs pull-up with decoupling cap. GPIO1=TXD, GPIO3=RXD for UART0.

Real-time clock (RTC) with I2C interface and integrated TCXO/crystal. The actual library name is 'DS3231-keyboard'. INT is active-low interrupt/alarm output. RST is active-low reset output. Vbat is backup battery input. Many NC pins (5-12) should be left unconnected.

A4988 stepper motor driver breakout board. VMOT is motor supply (8-35V), VDD is logic supply (3.3V or 5V). STEP and DIR control stepping. MS1/MS2/MS3 set microstepping mode. 1A/1B and 2A/2B are motor coil outputs. RESET and SLEEP are active low (tie together if not used). ENABLE is active low.

3.3V fixed-output LDO regulator, 600mA, SOT-23-5. Low quiescent current. EN pin enables/disables output.

3.3V fixed-output LDO regulator, 1A, SOT-223. Pin 2 (OUTPUT) and pin 4 (VOUT) are both output pins and should be connected together.
5V fixed positive voltage regulator, 500mA, SOT-223. Pin 3 (G) is ground (named G in symbol).
3.8V-32V input, 2A synchronous buck converter, SOT-23-6L. Integrated high/low-side MOSFETs. BST pin requires bootstrap capacitor to SW.
5V fixed-output step-down (buck) switching regulator, 1A, TO-263-5. Requires external inductor, diode, and capacitors. ON/OFF pin: connect to GND to enable, or drive high to disable.
5V output DC-DC converter module (non-isolated), 1A, SIP-3. Drop-in replacement for 7805. Input range 6.5V-36V. No external components required.
Unregulated inverting charge pump, SOT-23-5. Generates negative output voltage equal to -(VIN). Requires external flying capacitor between C_{FLY+} and C_{FLY-}, and output capacitor on OUT.
NPN bipolar transistor, 45V 100mA, SOT-23. General-purpose small-signal amplifier/switch.
NPN bipolar transistor, 40V 600mA, TO-92. General-purpose switching/amplifier.
Generic NPN bipolar transistor, CBE pinout. Use value field to set part number.
Generic N-channel MOSFET, GSD pinout. Use value field to set part number.
Generic P-channel MOSFET, GSD pinout. Use value field to set part number. Gate driven relative to source (Vgs < 0 to turn on).
N-channel MOSFET, 50V 220mA, SOT-23. Commonly used as logic-level shifter with pull-up resistors on both sides.
N-channel MOSFET, 30V 5.7A, SOT-23. Logic-level gate threshold (~1.4V). Low Rds(on).
P-channel MOSFET, -30V -4A, SOT-23. Logic-level gate threshold. Vgs < 0 to turn on (source connects to high-side rail).
N-channel power MOSFET, 100V 33A, TO-220. Standard gate threshold (~4V, not logic-level). Requires gate driver or sufficient gate voltage.
P-channel MOSFET, -20V -2.5A, SOT-23. Logic-level gate. Commonly used for high-side load switch.
N-channel MOSFET, 20V 4.2A, SOT-23. Logic-level gate threshold (~0.9V). Low Rds(on).
N-channel MOSFET, 60V 500mA, SOT-23. General-purpose small-signal MOSFET.
NPN high-voltage transistor, 300V 500mA, SOT-23. Used for high-voltage switching.
NPN general-purpose transistor, 40V 200mA, SOT-23. SMD equivalent of 2N3904.

Full-bridge motor driver, 40V 3.5A peak, SOIC-8 + exposed pad. IN1/IN2 control the H-bridge output direction. VREF sets current limit via LSS sense resistor. PAD (pin 9) is exposed thermal pad, connect to GND.
Stepper motor driver carrier (Pololu-style breakout). Microstepping up to 1/16. VMOT is motor power (8-35V), VDD is logic power (3.3V or 5V). Two GND pins (10, 16).

Quadruple half-H driver, up to 36V 600mA per channel, DIP-16. VCC1 (pin 16) is logic supply (5V), VCC2 (pin 8) is motor supply (up to 36V). EN1,2 enables channels 1-2; EN3,4 enables channels 3-4. Four GND pins (4,5,12,13) also serve as heat sink.

Silent stepper motor driver carrier (Trinamic TMC2209). Up to 2A RMS, 256 microsteps. VM is motor power (5.5-28V), VIO is logic reference (3.3V or 5V). UART for configuration. SPRD enables SpreadCycle/StealthChop. Two GND pins (1, 7).

Three-phase sensorless BLDC motor driver, 6.2-28V, integrated FETs, HTSSOP-24 + exposed pad. I2C configurable. Internal charge pump (VCP/CPP/CPN). Internal buck converter (SW/SWGND) for VREG. Dual-pin motor outputs U(1,2), V(1,2), W(1,2) and VCC(1,2) must be connected in parallel. EP (pin 25) connect to GND.

Dual operational amplifier, DIP-8/SOIC-8. Two independent op-amps share V+ (pin 8) and V- (pin 4). Op-amp A: pins 1(out), 2(-), 3(+). Op-amp B: pins 7(out), 6(-), 5(+). Pin names use ~ for outputs and +/- for inputs; use pin numbers to distinguish the two op-amps.

6-axis IMU module (accelerometer + gyroscope), I2C interface. VCC is 3.3-5V. ADD pin sets I2C address (GND=0x68, VCC=0x69). INT is interrupt output. XDA/XCL are auxiliary I2C for external magnetometer.

Digital barometric pressure and temperature sensor, I2C/SPI, LGA-8. CSB selects interface: high=I2C, low=SPI. SDO sets I2C address (GND=0x76, VDDIO=0x77). VDDIO is I/O level reference. NOTE: pin 6 is shared by SDO and VDDIO in the KiCad symbol.

components.note: 1-Wire digital temperature sensor, -55 to +125 C, TO-92. DQ is the 1-Wire data bus (requires 4.7k pull-up to VDD). Supports parasitic power mode (VDD tied to GND).
16-bit delta-sigma ADC, 4 single-ended or 2 differential channels, I2C, MSOP-10. Programmable gain amplifier (PGA). ADDR pin sets I2C address. ALERT/RDY is conversion-ready / comparator output.
Analog-output Hall-effect sensor, automotive grade, SOT-23. Ratiometric output proportional to magnetic field. 2mV/Gs sensitivity (A2 variant).

Microphone amplifier with AGC and low-noise bias, TSSOP-14. MICIN is electret mic input. MICBIAS provides bias voltage for electret mic. MICOUT is amplified output. GAIN selects gain (GND=40dB, VDD=50dB, float=60dB). A/R sets attack/release ratio. CT/CG are AGC timing capacitors. TH sets AGC threshold. ~SHDN enables/disables (active low).

Li-ion/LiPo battery charger module with protection, USB micro input. OUT+/OUT- are load output (two pairs: pins 1,5 and 4,6). B+/B- connect to battery. Module includes charge management and over-discharge/over-current protection.

Li-ion/LiPo battery protection IC, SOT-23-6. Monitors for over-charge, over-discharge, and over-current. OD controls over-discharge protection MOSFET gate, OC controls over-charge protection MOSFET gate. CS is current sense input. TD is time delay capacitor. VCC connects to battery positive, GND to battery negative.

Li-ion/LiPo charge management controller with system power path, QFN-20. IN (pins 18,19) is USB/adapter input. OUT (pins 1,20) is system output. V_BAT (pins 14,15) connects to battery. V_BAT_SENSE (pin 16) is battery voltage sense. PROG1/PROG2/PROG3 set charge current and timers. THERM monitors battery temperature via NTC. CE enables charging. ~TE enables safety timer. SEL selects USB 100mA/500mA. ~PG is power-good output. STAT1/STAT2 are charge status LEDs. V_SS (pins 10,11,21) are ground.
